input: List three items a week on eBay for six months

gold.taskTitle: List three eBay items weekly for six months
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to consistently sell three items per week on eBay over a six-month period.

questions.title: What types of items are you planning to sell?
questions.description: Understanding the category of items (e.g., clothing, electronics, collectibles, household goods) shapes sourcing, pricing, and listing strategy.

questions.title: Do you already have the inventory, or will you source it?
questions.description: Knowing whether items are already on hand or need to be found each week affects how far in advance planning must happen.

questions.title: Do you have an existing eBay seller account set up?
questions.description: Determines whether account creation, verification, and payment setup are prerequisites before any listing can begin.

questions.title: What is your target price range per item?
questions.description: Price range influences listing format choice (auction vs. Buy It Now), fees, shipping logistics, and overall revenue goals.

questions.title: Which day of the week do you plan to publish listings?
questions.description: Pinning down a specific listing day helps build a repeatable weekly routine and allows for scheduling reminders.

questions.title: Will you handle shipping yourself or use a third-party service?
questions.description: Shipping method affects how listings are structured, what handling time to advertise, and what supplies need to be on hand.

questions.title: What does success look like to you after six months?
questions.description: Understanding the end goal (e.g., a specific revenue target, clearing clutter, building a side business) ensures the plan is aligned with the user's true motivation.
